display_long_description:
# 🦀 Play as a Crab
Step into the claws of a mischievous beach crab in **Be A Crab**. Here, you don’t just play the crab… **Be A Crab**, and this is my world! Use your VR hands as powerful claws to grab, lift, throw, and interact with everything around you.

[media]

# 🦀 True Sandbox Freedom
Explore a lively beach island with complete freedom. Touch, move, and experiment with fully physics-driven objects in an interactive VR playground.
[media]

# 🦀 Do Whatever You Want
Live your best crab life — take photos, start dance parties, explore hidden spots, or just roam the island. There are no limits to how you play.
[media]

# 🦀 Create Fun Chaos
Knock things over, mess with NPCs, and watch dynamic reactions unfold. The island responds to your actions — sometimes in hilarious ways.
[media]

# 🦀 Packed with Activities
Complete fun beach missions and mini-challenges scattered across the island. Every task offers new interactions and unexpected outcomes.
[media]

# 🦀 Physics-Based Claw Interaction
Experience realistic VR claw mechanics powered by physics. Every grab, throw, and collision feels natural, weighty, and satisfying.
[media]

# 🦀 Annoy the Islanders
Sneak up, interrupt activities, and provoke funny NPC reactions. Tease, prank, and stir up trouble because you’re a crab.

[media]
